import json
import runpy
import sqlite3
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path
from yorunge import api
from yorunge.adapters import state, state_schema
from yorunge.domain.errors import YorungeError

seed = runpy.run_path('tests/fixtures/seed_migration_state.py')['seed']
version = int(sys.argv[1])
maximum = sys.argv[2] == 'maximum'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='.local', prefix='v2-limit-') as folder:
    root = Path(folder).resolve() / 'state'
    preparing = time.perf_counter()
    seed(root, version=version, maximum=maximum)
    prep = time.perf_counter()-preparing
    conn=sqlite3.connect(root/state.DB_NAME)
    sizes={}
    for table in ('capability_cache','execution_plans','execution_approvals'):
        if conn.execute('SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name=?',(table,)).fetchone():
            sizes[table]=conn.execute(f'SELECT count(*),sum(length(CAST(payload AS BLOB))),max(length(CAST(payload AS BLOB))) FROM {table}').fetchone()
    conn.close()
    started=time.perf_counter()
    error=None
    try:
        result=api.initialize_state(state_dir=root)
    except YorungeError as failure:
        error=failure.code
    elapsed=time.perf_counter()-started
    conn=sqlite3.connect(root/state.DB_NAME)
    after=conn.execute('PRAGMA user_version').fetchone()[0]
    valid=time.perf_counter()
    state.validate(conn,state_schema.MIGRATIONS,full=True)
    valid=time.perf_counter()-valid
    conn.close()
    print(json.dumps({'version':version,'maximum':maximum,'prep_seconds':prep,'sizes':sizes,'elapsed_seconds':elapsed,'error':error,'final_version':after,'post_validation_seconds':valid},indent=2))

    for table in ('capability_cache','execution_plans','execution_approvals'):
